name: Lucia Baez-Geller

items.why: This attack rests on her husband's law partner (Khurrum Wahid) and an endorsement from a civic group. It describes no conduct by her, so it is guilt by association, and no official finding backs the watchlist claim (criterion 2).

for_review: The Florida Politics article (item 1's source) could not be opened. I relied on its search-result excerpt and on the Miami Herald story, which I read in full. The Herald story says the $250,000 personal loan to her campaign came from her own funds, and it reports no finding that the money came from a foreign source. The one search on the owner's named sites found nothing about her from alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org or infowars.com. I did not check her campaign finance filings directly. I found nothing on the other criteria, such as foreign ties, big money or work history, and did not look further. Her record is that she taught for 15 years and served on the school board from 2020 to 2024.
